CustomField.description: Contributor Order Form "Content" column (16 Sep 2026): one text that names whatever the line carries - chapter (content slot jurisdiction or free-prose type + title), named individual (biography taker; hidden when the quote is No Names), scope, reports covered, word count, content type, order year, submission deadline, Intelligence office tier - and, for a cross-sold subscription line, the short licence label. Parts are joined with a middle dot; the leading separator is trimmed. 21 Sep 2026: a zero-fee add-on with nothing else to say (Bespoke PDF, print copies) prints "Included at no charge" rather than an empty cell.
CustomField.formula: MID( IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Content_Slot__r.Jurisdiction__c))), " · Chapter: " & TEXT(Content_Slot__r.Jurisdiction__c), IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Free_Prose_Type__c))), " · " & TEXT(Free_Prose_Type__c) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Free_Prose_Title__c)), ": " & Free_Prose_Title__c, ""), "")) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Bio_Taker__c)), IF(SBQQ__Quote__r.Order_Form_No_Names__c, " · Named individual", " · Named individual: " & Bio_Taker__r.FirstName & " " & Bio_Taker__r.LastName), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Scope__c))), " · Scope: " & TEXT(Scope__c), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Reports_Covered__c))), " · " & TEXT(Reports_Covered__c), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Number_of_Words__c))), " · " & TEXT(Number_of_Words__c) & " words", "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Content_Type__c))), " · " & TEXT(Content_Type__c), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Order_Year__c))), " · " & TEXT(Order_Year__c), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Submission_Deadline_Date__c)), " · Submission by " & TEXT(DAY(Submission_Deadline_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(MONTH(Submission_Deadline_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Submission_Deadline_Date__c)), "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Lexology_Intelligence_Office_Tier__c))), " · Office tier: " & TEXT(Lexology_Intelligence_Office_Tier__c), "") & IF(AND(ISBLANK(Bio_Taker__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Content_Slot__r.Jurisdiction__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Free_Prose_Type__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(License_Model__c)))), " · " & License_Model_Short__c, ""), 4, 1000) & IF(AND(SBQQ__NetTotal__c = 0, ISBLANK(TEXT(Content_Slot__r.Jurisdiction__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Free_Prose_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Bio_Taker__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Scope__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Reports_Covered__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Number_of_Words__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Content_Type__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Order_Year__c)), ISBLANK(Submission_Deadline_Date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Lexology_Intelligence_Office_Tier__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(License_Model__c))), "Included at no charge", "")
CustomField.label: Order Form: content
